# Chinese (Simplified) voice commands. Most lines are from the vendor's published Chinese command list (used as a coverage
# checklist); lines the list lacks were translated for this project and have NOT been reviewed by a native speaker.
# Format: English => Chinese. {braces} mark the variable part; tests remove the braces.
